[list]
[*] Adaptive performance now accelerates with stealthy precision hinting at hidden strengths.
[*] Color space conversion has shifted from Linear to Gamma revealing secret depths of vibrancy.
[*] Our intimate narrator has grown bolder and more playful whispering subtle encouragement with every keystroke.
[*] Panic button now preserves its last spark across sessions winking at those who dare to panic.
[*] Revamped active input handling slices through lag like a samurai blade ensuring your sudoku conquest remains flawless.
[*] Required installation footprint has slipped from 3.9 GB down to 970.6 MB moving with ninja‑like efficiency.
[*] Supercharged AI illustration marathons now conjure moonlit masterpieces that outshine mere mortals while nudging your imagination.
[/list]
⎛⎝ ≽>⩊<≼ ⎠⎞
Thanks for rolling with us from every corner of the world stay delightfully dicey with [b]Hentai Dice Sudoku![/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Background:[/b] [strike]Black[/strike] ⇒ Mirror
[*] [i]Dice sounds[/i] were added.
[*] [b]Fullscreen Mode:[/b] Exclusive Fullscreen [i](Alt+Enter)[/i] ⇒ Fullscreen Window [i](Alt+Enter)[/i]
[*] [i]Image effect shader[/i] was added.
[*] [i]Adaptive performance[/i] has been improved.
[*] The exit shortcut known as the panic combo [i](Alt+F4)[/i] has been made faster. The last level you could reach is still presented to Steam without any problems.
[*] The [b][X] Panic Button[/b] [i](ESC/P/X)[/i] can also turn on and off newly added effects and reflections. You can still continue using it without panicking. ^^
[/list]
